methods.summary: List the subgraphs deployed to this instance.
methods.description:
List the subgraphs deployed to this instance.

Each summary has the status, the last processed block against the chain tip, progress, `gapCount`, and an `integrity` flag.

methods.summary: Get a subgraph's health, sync position, and tables.
methods.description:
Get a subgraph's health, sync position, and tables.

The verify step after a deploy, reindex, or backfill: poll it until
`sync` catches the tip.

Get a subgraph's OpenAPI spec.

Describes the REST routes generated for each table. Pass `serverUrl` to set the server the spec advertises.

methods.summary: Get a subgraph's schema as JSON, shaped for agents.
methods.description:
Get a subgraph's schema as JSON, shaped for agents.

Per table: the endpoints, columns, indexes, which fields are sortable, selectable, searchable, or filterable, and a ready example query. Pass `serverUrl` to set the server the endpoints use.

methods.summary: Get a subgraph's generated API docs as Markdown text.
methods.description:
Get a subgraph's generated API docs as Markdown text.

Pass `serverUrl` to set the server the examples use.

Rebuild a subgraph from scratch.

A reindex always drops and rebuilds the whole subgraph, so it takes no
block range; the API rejects one with `REINDEX_RANGE_NOT_SUPPORTED`.
Use `backfill` to process a specific range. While a reindex or
backfill is already running the API answers 409 with code
`OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS`; poll `operations` until it finishes.

methods.summary: Stop a running reindex or backfill.
methods.description:
Stop a running reindex or backfill.

Requests the cancel and resolves with the `operationId` and a `cancel_requested` status. Poll `getOperation` until `status` is terminal. Throws a 404 with code `NO_OPERATION` when nothing is running.

returns.type: Promise<{ message: string; operationId?: string; status?: string }>

methods.description:
Process one block range. 409 `OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS` while another
reindex or backfill runs on this subgraph.

methods.summary: List the block ranges a subgraph is missing.
methods.description:
List the block ranges a subgraph is missing.

Each gap has its `start`, `end`, `size`, `reason`, and when it was detected and resolved. `resolved` filters to resolved or open gaps; page with `limit` and `offset`. `meta` reports the total gap count and total missing blocks.

params.name: opts
params.type: { limit?: number; offset?: number; resolved?: boolean }

methods.summary: Delete a subgraph and its tables.
methods.description:
Delete a subgraph and its tables.

Permanent. The API cancels any running reindex or backfill first, waits up to 5 seconds for it to stop, then drops the subgraph's tables and registry entry. `force: true` is sent as `?force=true`.

methods.summary: Read a table's rows, one cursor page at a time.
methods.description:
Read a table's rows, one cursor page at a time.

Anon works on an open instance; pass an apiKey on the client where reads
are closed. `next_cursor` is set
on every page that returned rows and is `null` only on an empty page, so a
poller tails with `cursor = page.next_cursor ?? cursor`. A paging loop
ends on an empty page (or one shorter than `limit`).

params.name: params
params.type: { limit?: number; filters?: Record<string, string>; fields?: string; sort?: string; order?: string } & { cursor?: string }

methods.summary: Recent reindex/backfill operations for a subgraph, newest first.
methods.description: Recent reindex/backfill operations for a subgraph, newest first.

methods.summary: Get the status of one reindex, backfill, or stop operation.
methods.description:
Get the status of one reindex, backfill, or stop operation.

Poll the `operationId` returned by `reindex`, `backfill`, or `stop`
until `status` is terminal.

Get a deployed subgraph's source.

Returns `sourceCode`, the bundled `handlerCode` the runtime executes, and the `pin` hash of what you deployed. `handlerCode` and `pin` are `null` for local deploys. A subgraph deployed before source was captured returns `sourceCode: null` and `readOnly: true` with a `reason`; redeploy it to capture the source.

methods.summary: Bundle a TypeScript subgraph source on the server.
methods.description:
Bundle a TypeScript subgraph source on the server. Used by the web chat
authoring loop so Vercel's serverless runtime doesn't have to run esbuild.

methods.summary: Count the rows in a table that match a filter.
methods.description:
Count the rows in a table that match a filter.

The count is exact. Same auth posture as `rows`.

methods.summary: Compute scalar aggregates over a table's matching rows.
methods.description:
Compute scalar aggregates over a table's matching rows.

Same auth posture as `rows`.

methods.summary: Returns a typed client for a subgraph defined with `defineSubgraph()`.
methods.description:
Returns a typed client for a subgraph defined with `defineSubgraph()`.
Row types are inferred from the subgraph's schema literal types.

types.name: DeploySubgraphRequest
types.summary: The body for deploying a subgraph: sources, schema, and handler code.

fields.name: startBlock
fields.description: Override the definition's startBlock for this deploy only.

fields.name: sourceCode
fields.description: Original TypeScript source, persisted so chat can read/diff/edit later.

fields.name: dryRun
fields.description: Validate the definition + print the DDL plan without deploying.

types.name: DeploySubgraphResponse
types.summary: What a deploy did, the version, and where indexing starts.

fields.name: start_block
fields.description: Effective indexing start height.

fields.name: estimatedEvents
fields.description:
Bounded candidate-event denominator for the reindex just started, when the
op was classifiable as sparse/light. Absent for heavy ops (no upfront estimate
possible) — check `sl subgraphs status` after ~30s for a rate-based ETA instead.

fields.name: warnings
fields.description: Non-blocking deploy lints (e.g. handler reads a print field never observed on-chain).

fields.name: pin
fields.description: sha256 identity of what was deployed; absent on unbundled deploys.

fields.name: diff
fields.type: { addedTables: string[]; removedTables: string[]; addedColumns: Record<string, string[]>; breakingChanges: string[] }

types.name: ReindexResponse
types.summary: A queued reindex and the block range it covers.

types.name: SubgraphAgentSchema
types.summary: A subgraph's tables and columns in a form agents can read.

fields.name: tables
fields.type: Record<string, { endpoint: string; countEndpoint: string; aggregateEndpoint?: string; streamEndpoint?: string; rowCount: number; columns: Record<string, { type: string; nullable?: boolean; indexed?: boolean; searchable?: boolean; default?: string | number | boolean }>; indexes?: readonly readonly string[][]; uniqueKeys?: readonly readonly string[][]; query: { parameters: string[]; sortable: string[]; selectable: string[]; searchable: string[]; filters: string[] }; examples: { list: Record<string, unknown>; count: { count: number }; curl: string } }>

types.name: SubgraphDetail

fields.name: pin

sha256 over schema, handler bundle, startBlock, network and runtime.

fields.name: verification
fields.description: Null for subgraphs deployed before levels were derived.

fields.name: health
fields.type: { totalProcessed: number; totalErrors: number; errorRate: number; lastError: string | null; lastErrorAt: string | null; emptyMapping: boolean }

fields.name: tables
fields.type: Record<string, { endpoint: string; columns: Record<string, { type: string; nullable?: boolean; indexed?: boolean; searchable?: boolean; default?: string | number | boolean }>; rowCount: number; example: string; indexes?: readonly readonly string[][]; uniqueKeys?: readonly readonly string[][] }>

types.name: SubgraphRowsEnvelope
types.summary: /v1 cursor envelope for subgraph table reads.

types.name: SubgraphSource
types.summary: A deployed subgraph's source code, handler bundle, and pin.

fields.name: handlerCode
fields.description: The bundled handler the runtime executes; null for local deploys.

fields.name: pin
fields.description: sha256 of `pinPreimage`; null for local deploys.

fields.name: pinPreimage
fields.description:
The canonical JSON the pin hashes (handler hash, network, runtime,
schema hash, startBlock); null before it was stored.

types.name: SubgraphSpecOptions
types.summary: Options for generating a subgraph's agent schema.

types.name: SubgraphSummary
types.summary: A subgraph's name, status, and indexing progress.

fields.name: integrity
fields.description: history_filling = expected gaps while a tip-first backfill op runs.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Most recent indexing error reason + when it occurred, if any.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last row mutation timestamp; powers per-card freshness.

fields.name: chainTip
fields.description:
Backward-compatible denominator for progress displays. During reindexing,
this is the reindex target block rather than the live source chain tip.

fields.name: queue
fields.type: { position: number | null; estimatedEvents: number | null; estimatedStartSeconds: number | null }
fields.description:
Present while the populating operation is queued: approximate claim
position + honest event denominator + naive start estimate.

fields.name: estimatedEvents
fields.description:
Event-based progress for sparse syncs (block pct is meaningless when
most heights are skipped).

fields.name: gaps
fields.type: { count: number; totalMissingBlocks: number; ranges: SubgraphGapRange[] }

fields.name: integrity
fields.description: history_filling = expected gaps while a tip-first backfill op runs.

types.name: SubgraphVerification
types.summary: How far a subgraph's rows can be checked without trusting the server, derived from its sources and a scan of its handler.

fields.name: reasons
fields.description:
What stands between the subgraph and checkable rows, e.g.
`print_event source "swaps" needs event proofs` or
`subgraph.ts:41:12 Date: wall-clock time differs per run`.

fields.name: unproven
fields.description: What stays unproven even at this level, e.g. tx attribution of writes.
